# Spreadsheet import fixtures

Each file holds the same two German contacts, unless noted. The files test that the list import and the workspace setup read what people really upload.

| File | Written by |
| --- | --- |
| `comma-utf8.csv`, `comma-utf8-bom.csv`, `comma-utf8-lf.csv`, `semicolon-utf8.csv`, `semicolon-utf8-bom.csv` | A script, as Excel's "CSV UTF-8" and other tools write them |
| `semicolon-macroman.csv` | A script, in Mac Roman, the encoding of a plain CSV from Excel for Mac |
| `semicolon-cp1252.csv` | A script, in Windows-1252, the encoding of a plain CSV from Excel for Windows |
| `libreoffice.xlsx` | LibreOffice Calc |
| `legacy-biff8.xls` | LibreOffice Calc, as "Excel 97-2003" |
| `excel95-biff5.xls` | SheetJS, as Excel 5.0/95 (BIFF5), with the umlauts put back as the Windows-1252 bytes Excel 95 writes (SheetJS writes them as `_`); LibreOffice no longer writes this format |
| `excel95-genuine.xls` | Microsoft Excel 95, a table of numbers and their squares, not the contacts. From the [Apache POI test data](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/spreadsheet/testEXCEL_95.xls), Apache License 2.0. |
| `xml-2003.xls` | LibreOffice Calc, as "Microsoft Excel 2003 XML", with the `.xls` name Excel gives such files |
| `html-table.xls` | LibreOffice Calc, as HTML, with the `.xls` name many web applications give their Excel exports |
| `excel-mac-16.xlsx` | Microsoft Excel 16 for Mac (`docProps/app.xml`: Microsoft Macintosh Excel 16.0300). A Title, Country and Position table, not the contacts. From the [Apache POI test data](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/spreadsheet/64759.xlsx), Apache License 2.0. |
| `namespace-{contacts,blank-rows,multiple-sheets,unicode}-{default,prefixed}.xlsx` | Generated by `python3 tests/fixtures/spreadsheet-import/generate-namespace-fixtures.py`. Four equivalent pairs reproduce the namespace failure reported in the native Mac regression run on 2026-11-02. These are independent reproductions, not copies of the Mac artifacts. |
| `mac-2026-11-02/files/c*.xlsx` | The eight exact files from the owner's Mac regression: C01/C10/C11/C12 and their normalized counterparts C24/C25/C26/C27. Generated using `@oai/artifact-tool`, then tested in native Safari and Chrome on macOS. These are not fresh Excel or Numbers exports. Original bytes, SHA-256 sums, manifest and validation report are preserved in that directory. |

The namespace pairs differ only in XML namespace prefixes. The prefixed variants use `x:` for SpreadsheetML tags, `link:` for relationship attributes, `pkg:` for package relationships and `ct:` for content types. They exercise shared strings, blank source rows, multiple worksheets, styles, a date, a boolean, a cached formula result, combining marks and emoji. Text containing `x:`, XML metacharacters and umlauts must survive unchanged. ZIP timestamps are fixed so regeneration is deterministic.

`patches/exceljs+4.4.0.patch` resolves the SpreadsheetML and package element names by namespace URI and canonicalizes relationship attributes for ExcelJS's existing transforms. Other namespace names and cell text are preserved. It patches the Node reader and the separately distributed browser reader. The package's browser entry uses the readable distribution so this small patch can be reviewed; Next.js minifies the final browser bundle as usual.
